name: 10_stock_drink_shelf
title: Restocking Drinks and Sorting Snacks
summary: A dual-arm robot places an iced lemon tea bottle on the upper shelf, sorts snacks below into a box, and verifies the stocked shelves.
robot: two black robotic arms with parallel grippers and wrist-mounted sensor modules
setting: a convenience store aisle with wooden shelves holding various bottled and canned beverages, with snack items below

source.original_prompt: Place the held iced lemon tea on the shelf at the position with iced lemon tea using right arm

segments.instruction: The right arm lifts the green iced lemon tea bottle toward the top shelf next to the existing green bottles while the camera remains focused forward.
The right arm positions the green bottle upright next to the other green tea bottles on the top shelf and releases its grip.
The robot retracts its arms and tilts its head down to look at the snack items on the lower level, panning away from the top shelf.
segments.memory_event: hide: top shelf with the stocked green tea bottle leaves camera view

segments.instruction: The left gripper reaches down and grasps a colorful snack bag lying on the lower shelf.
The left gripper places the snack bag into a storage box on the floor and pushes the box flap shut.
segments.memory_event: hide: snack bag enclosed inside the box

segments.instruction: The robot tilts its head back up to view the upper beverage shelves.
segments.memory_event: return: top shelf returns to view with the newly placed green tea bottle beside the other green bottles

segments.instruction: The right gripper grasps the small clear juice bottle on the upper shelf and slides it slightly to the right.
The robot tilts its head down toward the floor, and the left gripper opens the box flap.
segments.memory_event: return: opened box reveals the snack bag placed inside earlier
